steps.note: S1.1 restates the lemma (adds x_S to y_S whatever the scratch wires hold) but never gives the net change (JV+RG)x or the reason, that rows 6-7 restore the side and central values.
The bit-case coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side cancellation of the intersection-one cases and the self coefficient one appear nowhere in the plan.
The complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side cancellation of intersections zero and two are not stated.

S1.2 states the lemma's endpoint (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) from three invocations with the middle one reversed, but not the stage trace (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) or the inverse X<-X-Y that produces it.
S1.3/S1.4 give only the general definition (residual dimension = absolute label change) and that adjacent labels are nested; the per-edge residual table with its dimensions is absent.
The side edge 2->5 argument (t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> in t_Y^perp, complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2) is not in the plan.

S1.5 and S1.7 assert the totals Wm-2N, Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich, but the plan never says center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, and gives neither the telescoping at gates nor the source sum N and sink sum Wm-N that yield the signed total.
Nothing in the plan says that binary residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating, or that they have orthonormal bases with alternating planes absorbed.
S1.8 gives L_b/N=100/539 but the plan never states L_c/N=101/539; S1.9 says only that both ratios are below one half, so the sub-step is only half stated.
Additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and the phase difference sum over an orthonormal residual basis are absent; S1.12 gives only the count s_c.
The odd weight, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} and the conversion by H diag(1,-1) H = X into a translation kernel aI+bX_v are not stated.
The plan does not say that on k columns each residual vector contributes one tensored factor, s_c in all.
The endpoint frames I and C^{tensor m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, and the negated X outputs are all missing.

The plan states L<N/2 (S1.6, S1.9), s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with s_b<W_b m (S1.10-S1.11), s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m (S1.12), and S1's motivation ties a small lost dimension to the deficit, consistent with the paper.
The relative deficit eta_b=339/22587335000000 is not stated anywhere in the plan.
The relative deficit eta_c=73/19906842167500 is not stated anywhere in the plan.
S1.13-S1.15 assert tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} and s/W<m^tau without the derivation: the deficits exceeding 20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta).
The plan cites triangular-factorization only as a dependency and never gives the elimination proof of A=E_1 Pi E_2 or the count of a ones in Pi.
The fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator, so that the factorizations specialize to Z/q^b with invertible factors, is not mentioned.
S2.1 says only 'linear extra work' and does not say that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order.
S2.1 asserts 'exactly a interchanges' but not the three-step implementation D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, one interchange per one of Pi.
None of the guard constants E, B, nu, C_1, C_0, Delta, or the values nu=11 and C_1=20, appear in the plan.
S2.2.2's F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) is the time recurrence for the interchange, not the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with A(e)<=8e at a leaf.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are absent.
The depth-to-size bound, the reserved p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits, and the step from epsilon C_1<1 to Delta=o(p) are not stated.
S3.4 asserts the sqrt2*2^{-p} error after one final truncation, but not the reason: each row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved.

summary: P05 restates the paper's lemma and proposition conclusions (the bank exchange endpoint, the rank budget Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, L_b/N, s<Wm, tau=sigma, s/W<m^tau, a interchanges per rank-a shear, the sqrt2*2^{-p} truncation error) mostly as bare quotes, and almost never carries the sub-derivations behind them. Only R1 (L<N/2 gives s<Wm) is present; the residual table, the F_2 orthonormal bases, the complex phase interface, the explicit deficits, the triangular-factorization mechanics and the whole guard-width analysis are absent. No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
